## MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the Current Market Regime?
NEUTRAL regime — normal volatility (Vol: 25.1%) with narrow participation; breadth 0/8 sectors positive signals market stalled despite subdued vol.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Banking, Holding and Transportation are the relative leaders: YKBNK (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +1.08%) ABOVE TREND; ISCTR (1W: +1.74% | 1M: -3.59%) RECOVERY; SAHOL (1W: +2.16% | 1M: -5.85%) RECOVERY.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Construction, Technology and Energy remain weakest: TKFEN (1W: -23.77% | 1M: -21.71%) BELOW TREND; KONTR (1W: -18.66% | 1M: -46.03%) BELOW TREND; SASA (1W: -10.36% | 1M: -28.51%) BELOW TREND.

## STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
SAHOL (1W: +2.16% | 1M: -5.85%) RECOVERY; ISCTR (1W: +1.74% | 1M: -3.59%) RECOVERY; GARAN (1W: +1.70% | 1M: -0.75%) RECOVERY; YKBNK (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +1.08%) ABOVE TREND; SOKM (1W: -1.03% | 1M: +0.79%) CORRECTION.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
TKFEN (1W: -23.77% | 1M: -21.71%) BELOW TREND; KONTR (1W: -18.66% | 1M: -46.03%) BELOW TREND; TRMET (1W: -12.60% | 1M: -9.09%) BELOW TREND; ULKER (1W: -10.74% | 1M: -12.33%) BELOW TREND; SASA (1W: -10.36% | 1M: -28.51%) BELOW TREND.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Highest absolute 1W movers: TKFEN (1W: -23.77% | 1M: -21.71%) BELOW TREND; KONTR (1W: -18.66% | 1M: -46.03%) BELOW TREND; TRMET (1W: -12.60% | 1M: -9.09%) BELOW TREND; ULKER (1W: -10.74% | 1M: -12.33%) BELOW TREND; SASA (1W: -10.36% | 1M: -28.51%) BELOW TREND.

## SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Banking Sector Outlook?
Banking is the relative safe harbor but still soft (1W: -1.30% | 1M: -5.40%). Watch YKBNK (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +1.08%) ABOVE TREND and RECOVERY signals in ISCTR (1W: +1.74% | 1M: -3.59%) and GARAN (1W: +1.70% | 1M: -0.75%), while AKBNK (1W: -1.47% | 1M: -6.57%) remains BELOW TREND.

8. Industrial Sector Outlook?
Heavy industry showing broad weakness with isolated divergence: EREGL (1W: -2.84% | 1M: +0.33%) CORRECTION is the clearest relative performer, while FROTO (1W: -7.17% | 1M: -10.52%) and TOASO (1W: -7.77% | 1M: -14.84%) remain BELOW TREND.

9. Energy & Chemicals Outlook?
Energy & Chemicals are under pressure and confirm sector-wide selloff: TUPRS (1W: -2.78% | 1M: -7.23%) BELOW TREND; SASA (1W: -10.36% | 1M: -28.51%) BELOW TREND; GUBRF (1W: -9.83% | 1M: -12.19%) BELOW TREND.

## PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Remain underweight cyclicals and high-volatility names, trim positions showing structural underperformance and reallocate selectively to banking exposure (YKBNK, GARAN, ISCTR) and cash; keep stop discipline on momentum losers (TKFEN, KONTR, SASA).

## NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
YKBNK (1W: +0.73% | 1M: +1.08%) ABOVE TREND for continuation; GARAN (1W: +1.70% | 1M: -0.75%) RECOVERY for earnings/flow; TKFEN (1W: -23.77% | 1M: -21.71%) BELOW TREND for volatility and potential squeeze; KONTR (1W: -18.66% | 1M: -46.03%) BELOW TREND as a high-risk trade.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
Banking & Finance for relative stability and flow; Energy & Chemicals for downside continuation; Technology & Telecom for further dispersion/high beta moves.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch XU100 reaction to its 20-day moving average and recent 1-month low for confirmation of the downside; a sustained volatility uptick above ~30% would flip bias to risk-off, while breadth recovery to ≥3/8 sectors positive would signal rotation back into cyclical names.

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
NEUTRAL market with normal vol (25.1%) but zero sector breadth — a narrow, risk-averse tape. Favor selective banking exposure (YKBNK/ISCTR/GARAN) and keep stops on high-volatility losers (TKFEN, KONTR, SASA); breadth and volatility moves will determine the next decisive leg.
